info.name: Uber Backend - Full API Collection
info.description:
Complete API collection for Uber Backend microservices project.

## Services
- **Auth Service** (port 7474) — Passenger authentication
- **Booking Service** (port 7777) — Ride bookings
- **Review Service** (port 7475) — Booking reviews (full CRUD)
- **Location Service** (port 7478) — Driver location tracking (Redis GEO)
- **Socket Service** (port 8086) — WebSocket/STOMP for real-time ride requests

## Gateway
All APIs are accessible via the API Gateway at `http://localhost:8080`.

## WebSocket
- STOMP endpoint: `ws://localhost:8086/ws`
- App destination prefix: `/app`
- Topic prefix: `/topic`

request.description:
Create a new ride booking.

**Request Body:** `CreateBookingDto`
- `passengerId` (Long)
- `startLocation` — `ExactLocation { latitude, longitude }`
- `endLocation` — `ExactLocation { latitude, longitude }`

**Headers:**
- `Idempotency-Key` (optional) — Prevents duplicate bookings on retries

Auto-saves `bookingId` on success.

Update booking status and optionally assign a driver.

**Path Variable:** `bookingId` (Long)

**Request Body:** `UpdateBookingRequestDto`
- `status` (String) — One of: `DRIVER_ASSIGNED`, `DRIVER_ACCEPTED`, `DRIVER_ARRIVING`, `RIDE_STARTED`, `IN_RIDE`, `COMPLETED`, `CANCELLED`
- `driverId` (Long, optional) — Required when status is `DRIVER_ASSIGNED`
Transition booking to DRIVER_ARRIVING status.
Transition booking to RIDE_STARTED (passenger picked up).
Transition booking to IN_RIDE.
Complete the ride.
Cancel the booking.

Publish a review for a completed booking.

**Request Body:** `CreateReviewDto` (validated)
- `bookingId` (Long) — Must reference a valid booking
- `content` (String) — Review text
- `rating` (Double) — 0.0 to 5.0

Auto-saves `reviewId` on success.

item.name: Raise New Ride Request (Broadcast to Drivers)

request.description:
Broadcasts a ride request to nearby drivers via WebSocket STOMP (`/topic/rideRequest`).

**Request Body:** `RideRequestDto`
- `passengerId` (Long)
- `startLocation` — `ExactLocation { latitude, longitude }`
- `endLocation` — `ExactLocation { latitude, longitude }`
- `driverIds` (List<Long>) — Driver IDs to broadcast to
- `bookingId` (Long)

**Internal:** Sends the request to STOMP topic `/topic/rideRequest`.

item.description:
WebSocket/STOMP service for real-time ride updates.

## WebSocket Connection
- **STOMP Endpoint:** `ws://localhost:8086/ws` (SockJS enabled)
- **App Destination Prefix:** `/app`
- **Topic Prefix:** `/topic`

## STOMP Destinations
| Direction | Destination | Payload | Description |
|-----------|------------|---------|-------------|
| Subscribe | `/topic/rideRequest` | `RideRequestDto` | Receive new ride requests (for drivers) |
| Subscribe | `/topic/ping` | `TestResponse` | Ping/pong test |
| Send | `/app/rideResponse/{userId}` | `RideResponseDto { response: Boolean, bookingId: Long }` | Driver accepts/rejects ride |
| Send | `/app/ping` | `TestRequest { data: String }` | Ping test |

item.name: 🔄 Full Ride Flow (Run in Order)
Step 3 — Save Driver Location (simulate nearby driver)

item.description:
Run these requests in order to simulate a complete ride lifecycle:
1. Register a passenger
2. Sign in the passenger (gets JWT cookie)
3. Save a driver's location (simulate a nearby driver)
4. Create a booking (passenger requests a ride)
5. Assign a driver to the booking
6. Start the ride
7. Complete the ride
8. Leave a review

**Note:** Test scripts auto-save `passengerId`, `bookingId`, and `reviewId` between steps.
